message.content:
## Recent developments
* **Financial Milestone & Revenue Growth:** Perplexity AI's annual run-rate recently topped US$750 million, tripling its revenue over the past year. Growth has been driven heavily by enterprise expansion (with clients like PayPal running tens of thousands of queries weekly) and integration into mobile ecosystems like Samsung's Galaxy S26.
* **Agentic Features Expansion ("Teammates"):** Perplexity expanded its agentic workspace features, rolling out "Teammates"—proactive AI agents designed to handle collaborative workflows like QA, customer service, and research—to the Mac app for Max subscribers after initial web/iOS rollouts.
* **Model & Open-Weights Releases:** Perplexity launched open weights for its specialized decision and text-classification models, `pplx-decider-v1.3` and `pplx-decider-flash-v1.3`, on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license. These models leverage fine-tuned Qwen architectures to handle complex text-span extraction and automated research tasks.
* **Legal Headwinds:** Perplexity faces a new class action lawsuit filed in California federal court alleging that the company misled consumers regarding undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features.

## Talking points
* **Enterprise Scaling & Monetization:** Inquire about how enterprise adoption is scaling, particularly regarding security, compliance, and integration with heavy enterprise tech stacks (e.g., Microsoft Azure and AWS).
* **Agentic Workflows ("Teammates"):** Discuss the vision for collaborative AI agents on desktop/mobile and how Perplexity differentiates its agent orchestration platform from competing enterprise AI agents.
* **Open-Source Strategy:** Discuss the strategic reasoning behind releasing open-weights decision and routing models like `pplx-decider-v1.3` to the developer community.

## Open questions
* How is Perplexity addressing user retention and consumer trust in light of recent class action litigation concerning paid subscription usage caps?
* What are the monetization and infrastructure cost projections as agentic features like "Teammates" and heavy multi-model orchestration scale across a massive user base?
* How does Perplexity plan to sustain its competitive moat in search and answer engines against deeply entrenched big tech players (like Google and Microsoft)?

## Sources
* [Perplexity Decider v1.3 & Flash Open Weights — CASRAI](https://casrai.org/news/perplexity-pplx-decider-v1-3-open-weights-release-2026)
* [Perplexity: AI Answer Engine Tops US$750m Run-Rate | AI Magazine](https://aimagazine.com/news/perplexity-ai-answer-engine-tops-us-750m-run-rate)
* [Perplexity AI sued over undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features](https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/lawsuit-news/perplexity-ai-sued-over-undisclosed-usage-caps-on-paid-subscription-features)
* [Perplexity brings AI agents feature called Teammates to the Mac - 9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/13/perplexity-brings-ai-agents-feature-called-teammates-to-the-mac)
